title: Rabbah bar Kahana

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah at the end of the Petichtot, and Hyman suggests that the reference there is to Rabbi Abba bar Kahana. In Nazir 42a, according to [Tosafot on Nazir 42b:1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Nazir.42b.1.1), Rabbah bar Rav Kahana; but Hyman says the Gemara has Rabbah speaking in the name of Rav Huna, as it also implies when Rav Yosef later says “for Rav Huna said.”[^3]

notes.text: The consulted Davidson edition places the statement that Rabbah reports Rav Huna at the opening of the Gemara on Nazir 42b. Hyman cites 42a.
The consulted Gemara reads “Rabbah said in the name of Rav Huna” at [Nazir 42b:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.42b.1). Hyman supplies 42a and reports a different name from Tosafot.
The linked Tosafot gloss opens with Rabbah bar Rav Kahana. The corresponding Bavli, at the start of 42b, has Rabbah speaking in the name of Rav Huna. Hyman supplies 42a.
